# ADR 0034 amendment: an unproved seat loses authority, not the update

Part of neomjs/neo-agent-institution#732. This is the decision authority for neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1143, whose code merges after it.

## Context

On 2026-10-18, a single server's failed Neural Link proof refused the FM's whole continuity handoff (`refused at survivor-validation: proof failed: neural-link`). The successor booted after an unclean exit, so every running generation was stale, and from then on any running seat refused every update. The operator closed every harness by hand. The logs and code path are on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1143.

## The Problem

ADR 0034 §2.5 item 4 records that refusal as the decision: *"Unproved prerequisites remain a named refusal or legacy migration case"*. [D19723](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/19723) graduated it as *"Unproved prerequisites remain visible refusals/migration cases"*. The clause never says whose prerequisite. Read as written, one seat's unproved server refuses the update for every seat. That contradicts the terminal predicate of epic neomjs/neo-agent-institution#732, which must hold *"when a seat's server cannot prove its credential, when the previous FM exited uncleanly"*.

The invariant the clause protects is narrower than the refusal: no unproved authority crosses to the successor. Revoking only the unproved seat's or server's authority keeps that invariant and lets the update go ahead.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: ADR 0034 §2.5 item 4, quoted above, is the sentence amended here. The operator, 2026-10-18, on neomjs/neo-agent-institution#732: *"i also never ever want to come into the situation again that all harnesses need closing before an FM update."*

- ADR 0038 §2.5.2 already reasons per admission generation: *"unknown or unproved recovery is stale"*, and missing or failed proof *"leaves new-child admission stale"*. Its issuer-level duties (finish or visibly refuse pending transitions, durable publication, endpoint release) stay global. No change is needed.
- ADR 0034 item 5 retains a generation whose ownership is unknown, and item 6 keeps a legacy seat a named refusal. Neither changes.
- neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1143 builds the narrowed rule. A seat's unproved server loses its grant (`McpLaunchAdmissionService.revokeServerGrant`, bound to the generation, persisted). An unprovable seat loses its generation (`revoke(..., {generation})`) and is carried with `ownershipUnresolved`. The handoff still refuses on issuer-level conditions.

## The Fix

`learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md`: rewrite item 4's refusal sentence in place with a provenance bracket, add one case to the required installed witness, and add an amendment row to the header table.

- An issuer-level condition still refuses the handoff by name: issuer custody, durable publication, endpoint release, a pending Start, the deadline. A legacy seat stays a migration case (item 6).
- An unproved fact about one surviving seat revokes only the authority that seat would have carried. A server that cannot prove loses its grant. A seat whose pin, inputs or original Start cannot be proved loses its admission generation, and its runtime generation stays retained (item 5).
- Each revocation names the generation it ends, is durable before the issuer is replaced, and is never restored by a later observation. The update stops no seat, and existing children keep their inputs.
- An old active record after an unclean issuer loss is still not authority. It crosses as stale and admits nothing.

Decision Record impact: amends ADR 0034 §2.5 item 4; aligned-with ADR 0038 §2.5.2. There is no Discussion. This narrows D19723's refusal to the seat it concerns, and the amendment's cross-family review is the challenge path, as it was for #19818. @neo-gpt-sophie, who owns the continuity handoff, supports the bounded amendment and its negative controls (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1143, comment 6256571604).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Item 4 refuses the handoff only for issuer-level conditions and keeps the legacy case. A seat's unproved fact revokes only that seat's or server's authority.
- [ ] AC-2: Item 4 states the revocation's properties: it is bound to the generation it ends, durable before the issuer is replaced, and never restored by a later observation. A seat that loses its generation keeps its runtime generation retained, and the update stops no seat.
- [ ] AC-3: The required installed witness covers one seat's server failing its proof and an unclean predecessor. The header table carries the amendment row. Items 5–6 and ADR 0038 are unchanged.

## Out of Scope

- The implementation (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1143).
- The handoff's time budget and boot latency (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1081`, `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1142`).
- Installer behaviour on a refusal (a sibling leaf under neomjs/neo-agent-institution#732).
- This record's custody move to Institution (#19730). That cut binds an Engine revision, so it must include this amendment.
